test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Satiate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Satisfy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satiate** means to satisfy fully or to the point of excess.

Therefore, the most appropriate synonym for Satiate is **Satisfy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Meanings of the incorrect options:
 
 
• **Pamper** - to indulge with every attention, comfort, and kindness; spoil.
 
• **Culminate** - to reach the highest point or final stage.
 
• **Agitate** - to disturb or excite emotionally; arouse; perturb.
